title: B-2 colonel whispers about electrogravitics

tellings.quote: and he leaned forward and he just whispered, "That's bullshit."

plain: At a conference in Las Vegas in 2008, Richard Dolan says, a colonel connected with the B-2 stealth bomber leaned forward and whispered, "That's bullshit," as talk turned to electrogravitics, the idea, tied to the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, that electric charge can push against gravity. The talk was about a paper by Paul LaViolette arguing that the B-2 uses such a drive. Dolan, a researcher who writes about UFO secrecy, tells Michels he was there, and he offers the whisper as a telling reaction to the question of what really powers the bomber.
